text:
Gold Price in 2005
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2005, the LBMA gold price rose 21.5% between 2005-01-31 ($422) and 2005-12-29 ($513). The highest sampled price was $513 in December and the lowest was $414 in May. The mean of these observations was $449. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
